svg.text: % of each first-purchase cohort that buys again m months later (identified customers, n=5,852).
Blank cells are not yet observable (right-censored); offset 0 is the acquisition month (100%).
% buying again -- shade is binned for legibility; the exact % is printed in each cell.
Headline retention curve (size-weighted across observable cohorts)
Last complete month 2011-11; final month partial, excluded as a target.
Retention is measured from the real transactions, not modelled.
